# Sanity transforms

Plain functions that take what Sanity returns and reshape it for the templates.

## What's here

- `project.js`, `award.js`, `organization.js`, `home.js`, `navigation.js`, and similar: one per content type
- `imageUrls.js`: builds image URLs
- `portableText.js`: turns rich text into HTML

## How it connects

- Called by [services](../services/README.services.md) after each query returns.
